declarations.docstring: For a multi-index of the prescribed total degree, the weighted coefficient sum over the auxiliary polynomials equals a product of binomial coefficients.
A coefficient of the auxiliary permutation polynomial is a finite sum of products of the displayed auxiliary scalars and auxiliary polynomial coefficients.
Evaluation at one of the auxiliary permutation polynomial is the sum of its coefficients over the finitely supported antidiagonal.
Evaluation at one of the auxiliary permutation polynomial is a weighted sum of evaluations at one of the displayed auxiliary polynomials.
A factorial times the pointwise product sum equals the sum of products of the two displayed auxiliary weighted sums.
For a multi-index of fixed total degree, the sum of the displayed auxiliary finite-type cardinalities is a product of binomial coefficients.
